releases.name: Fallen City Brawl
releases.summary:
As a brutal battle for control of Fallen City's criminal underworld rages, four strangers join forces to survive and reclaim the streets! With a ferocious wolf at their sides, these unlikely allies will face impossible odds. Along the way, motivations and past lives will collide, further testing their loyalty as well as their fighting skills. Only by binding together can they reach the final showdown that will decide who lives and who falls.

Inspired by arcade beat 'em ups of the late '80s and early '90s, Fallen City Brawl is a story of ambition and revenge told through intense side-scrolling pixel art action.

releases.name: EA Sports FC 27
releases.summary:
Step into The Grounds, a social football playground where the streets meet the stadium. From Kickabouts and 1v1s to teaming up with friends in Clubs, connect with renowned football mentors, improve your abilities, and express yourself on and off the pitch. Feel greater control in every game mode with more fluid, true-to-life gameplay, featuring dynamic corners, enhanced attacking awareness, player-focused defending tailored for competitive play, and more community-driven innovations. Sign your next star in Manager Career through a rebuilt Transfer Market with realistic player values and active club bidding. Master new negotiation tactics, including performance and buy-back clauses, as Dynamic OVRs reflect player form, morale, and fitness across every club. Immortalise your dream club in Football Ultimate Team™ with the brand-new FUT Gallery. Curate your favourite Player Items to grow your Gallery Level, earn rewards, and build your Club’s identity throughout the new football season.
Experience unrivalled authenticity in EA SPORTS FC™ 27, with match data from the world’s top leagues powering 21,000+ licensed players. [EA Sports]

releases.name: Superstar Strategy
releases.summary:
Outfight and outwit your enemies in this turn-based tactics game. Use each unit's unique abilities and the terrain around you to your advantage to thwart your opponent's plans and reign supreme!

Push, pull, teleport, and displace your enemies onto traps to deal additional damage and apply status effects between rounds. If you are able to escape the trap before the new round starts, you can cheat fate!

With 14 different unit roles to choose from, you can create your own unique combinations to build your own personal army! Experiment with different units to find synergies and force multipliers to improve your chances of victory.

releases.name: Ghostly Whiskers
releases.summary:
Your beloved human has vanished into the night. As a pair of courageous cats, you’ll follow their scent to an abandoned mansion shrouded in fog and mystery. But this is no ordinary house — it’s alive with whispers, shadows, and secrets from the past.

Ghostly Whiskers is a short but unforgettable co-op (or solo) adventure that blends light horror with heartwarming moments. Solve puzzles, explore eerie rooms, and use your feline instincts — like squeezing through tight spaces, climbing ledges, and sniffing out hidden clues — to uncover the truth.

- Use your flashlight to reveal secrets in the dark
- Sniff out trails and memory fragments
- Explore a hand-crafted haunted mansion full of cozy, eerie charm
- Play solo or with a friend in split-screen co-op

releases.name: Beautiful Girls on Campus: Memories of Youth
releases.summary:
Memorize a snapshot of school life in just one minute! Study every detail, then put your memory to the test. Can you recall what was there?

How much can you remember from a single moment on campus?

Take one minute to carefully study an image of beautiful girls enjoying everyday school life. Then, after part of the scene is hidden, choose the correct answer from four options.

What was there before?
What did that part of the scene look like?

You never know which detail the question will focus on, so pay attention to the characters, objects, and surroundings.

You may feel certain you remember something, only to hesitate when the choices appear. Follow your memory, spot the detail you saw before, and enjoy that satisfying moment when the answer comes back to you.

Take in the youthful campus atmosphere, remember every detail you can, and see how much of each scene stays in your memory!

releases.name: Phantom Thief Mirage and the Curious Clues
releases.summary:
Can you spot the clue?

A clue may be hiding in plain sight. Will you notice it before it slips away?

Even when you think you have seen everything, an unexpected detail may still be waiting to be found.

Phantom Thief Mirage and the Curious Clues is a one-question, one-answer picture puzzle game. Study a single illustration and choose the spot that answers the question.

The rules are simple!

・Read the question
・Examine every part of the illustration
・Choose the spot you think is the answer

That flash of insight when you find the right place feels great! Even a miss can lead to a new discovery when you take another careful look.

Take on the challenge alone, or share the fun with family and friends by asking, “Where do you think it is?”
